name: rosetta-color-wheel

use default
use Raster.IMAGE

use Math = System.Math
use Colour = (red: ubyte, green: ubyte, blue: ubyte)

from_hsv(hue: double, saturation: double, value: double) -> Colour =>
    (let sextant = hue / 60.0D
     let rising = value * (1.0D - saturation)
     let falling =
         value * (1.0D - saturation * (sextant - Math.floor(sextant)))
     let climbing =
         value *
         (1.0D - saturation * (1.0D - sextant + Math.floor(sextant)))

     let channels =
         case cast int(Math.floor(sextant)) % 6
         when 0 then (red = value, green = climbing, blue = rising)
         when 1 then (red = falling, green = value, blue = rising)
         when 2 then (red = rising, green = value, blue = climbing)
         when 3 then (red = rising, green = falling, blue = value)
         when 4 then (red = climbing, green = rising, blue = value)
         else (red = value, green = rising, blue = falling)
         esac

     (red = cast ubyte(Math.round(255.0D * channels.red)),
      green = cast ubyte(Math.round(255.0D * channels.green)),
      blue = cast ubyte(Math.round(255.0D * channels.blue))))

let size = 480
let radius = 224.0D

let image = IMAGE(size, size)

image.clear(24ub, 24ub, 28ub)

let centre = 0.5D * cast double(size)

for pixel_y in 0..size do
    for pixel_x in 0..size do
        let across = cast double(pixel_x) + 0.5D - centre
        let down = cast double(pixel_y) + 0.5D - centre
        let away = Math.sqrt(across * across + down * down)
        let covered =
            Math.min(1.0D, Math.max(0.0D, radius + 0.5D - away))

        if covered > 0.0D then
            let angle = Math.atan2(-down, across) * 180.0D / Math.pi
            let turned =
                if angle < 0.0D then angle + 360.0D else angle fi

            image.colour(
                from_hsv(turned, Math.min(1.0D, away / radius), 1.0D))

            image.blend(pixel_x, pixel_y, covered)
        fi
    od
od

image.write("wheel.png")

write_line("hue   saturation 1, value 1")

for hue in 0::5 do
    let degrees = cast double(hue) * 60.0D
    let shade = from_hsv(degrees, 1.0D, 1.0D)

    write_line(
        "{degrees,3:F0}   "
        "{shade.red,4}{shade.green,4}{shade.blue,4}")
od

image.show("wheel.png")
